usedFor: TagMango holds creator courses and orders, and viaSocket utilities starts another workflow through “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in TagMango, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new order starts a second workflow, so one order can run a longer chain of steps.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” requires the ID of the child workflow, so have it ready before you build.
